description: Fork a branch from production (or `from`) for one task, agent or pull request: a copy-on-write database with its own URL and keys. Expires after ttl_hours. Returns its URL and publishable key once live. Scope: branches:write.

data.description: What to copy from the parent (default snapshot: schema and data, copy-on-write)

from_time.description: Optional RFC 3339 time, e.g. 2026-09-28T10:15:00Z: the branch holds its parent as it was then (inside the project's history window, shown on the Branches page)

organization_id.description: Organization id. Optional: defaults to the token's organization, or the only one you belong to.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional: defaults to the project created or used last in this session, or the only one.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait until it is live (default 60, 0 returns immediately)

name: branches.create
title: Create a branch
